newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong stocks trend firmer in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks trend firmer in early trade.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks opened firmer on Monday morning, banking on the good near term outlook for the market in spite of concerns about a possible U.S. interest rate hike, brokers said.
"Technical indicators on the daily chart are all buy," said Phil Chan, analyst at OCBC Securities Ltd.
The Hang Seng Index quickly rose 50 points, then eased to trade 30 points at the 11,620.00 in the first 30 minutes of trading. Turnover was HK$738.29 million.
"The market is neither a bargain nor expensive at this level," Chan said.
OCBC Securities puts the market on a price/earnings ratio of 13 times 1996 earnings and 11.5 times 1997 earnings.
"Historically, this level is not expensive, said Chan."And that is why we have seen the market moving in a large sideways pattern for the past eight months."
Brokers noted the results of property blue chips Hysan, Hang Lung and Amoy, announced last Friday, were in line with market expectations and had not given much of a boost to the market.
Hysan was us HK$0.20 at HK$23.85, Hang Lung was down HK$0.20 at HK$14.65, and Amoy was down HK$0.10 to HK$9.00.
Also in the property sector, Henderson Land advanced a strong HK$1.50 to HK$66.00, as the market continued to digest the group's large final dividend payout of HK$2.43, brokers said.
Sun Hung Kai Properties was up HK$0.50 to HK$79.50. The company will report its earnings for the year ended June 30 in early October.
New World Development, which is reportedly mulling a convertible bond issue, was unchanged at HK$39.40.
Utilities led the market on the back of a HK$0.15 rise in Hong Kong Telecom to HK$13.45.

Red chip COSCO Pacific was the most active stock in terms of turnover. The share eased HK$0.25 to HK6.65 after rising last week with the announcement that the share was to be included in the Hang Seng Mid-Cap 50 Index.
The company is to report interim earnings for the first six months of 1996 on Monday afternoon.
Newcomer Glorious Sun was also active with a total of HK$76 million in trade. The share added HK$0.175 to HK$2.70.
